findings: Several acceptance rationales infer a catalog defect from a limited inference without identifying the definition’s additional requirement.
Stable openly defended message-level standard is not itself a change in word meaning; preserve the frozen final critique and assess actual within-argument shifting.
Expert citation plus absent full calculation does not automatically show status treated as settling the argument.
Tenacity overextension is not automatically circularity; identify an assumed conclusion rather than incomplete inductive support.
A relevant theological-consequence reply is not automatically a diversion simply because local attribution remains unresolved.
P75 clarification is credited in the frozen critique, not judged a covert change of definition; label cannot add that new defect.
Education accompanies a preservation argument; identify actual substitution rather than treating practical application itself as diversion.
Historical-Bibles category overgeneralization is not automatically the catalog scale/magnitude bias.
